svg.text: Workers · Tasks · Converters · SMTs · Internal Topics
Workers communicate via Kafka internal topics · REST requests forwarded to leader
same connector · tasks distributed across workers
⚠ task restart is MANUAL — no auto-restart on FAILED
errors.tolerance=none (default) → task FAILS on 1 bad record
errors.tolerance=all → skip + send to DLQ topic
⚠ __consumer_offsets — normal Kafka topic — stores SINK connector offsets (not connect-offsets)
